The same department documents provincial land-record computerization, GIS cadastral mapping and land-record service workflows. scopeLimits: No citywide parcel coverage is asserted. No owner, address, title, tax, CNIC, contact, or other unsafe field was requested or retained.

officialSources.observation: Official KP settlement-progress document lists Malakand, Dargai and Skhakot and states that writing of Khatoni was under process along with GIS-based measurement. This is the strongest Sakhakot-specific cadastral/settlement evidence found.
Official Directorate message describes GIS-based cadastral mapping, digitization and integrated Service Delivery Centres across KP. It does not link an anonymous parcel feature service.

Official Directorate page assigns responsibility for land records, settlement, GIS-based cadastral mapping and database management; it exposes administrative/service information rather than safe parcel geometry.
Official KP LRMIS appointment/service portal describes computerized land-record services and lists service centers, but no public geometry-only endpoint.
Official CLRMIS portal requires account/biometric and name, father name and CNIC-based ownership workflow; it is not an anonymous parcel geometry source and was not queried.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: Reviewed the official KP Revenue, Directorate, SDLR, LRMIS and e-Fard entry points and followed their public descriptions. No current JavaScript/configuration-linked anonymous parcel map or feature service with safe ID+geometry fields was verified.
